history_assignment.instruction: Use the matching reported age-sex estimate exactly; fail rather than pool or substitute a different age or sex cell.

scope_note: The processed eligibility output provides adjusted pack-year distributions, not respondent-level joint histories of initiation age, intensity, duration, or stopping age.

status_assignment.daily_and_occasional_handling: already combined as smokers in the processed eligibility output
status_assignment.method: sample exactly one of current, former, or never using assignment_probability
status_assignment.not_stated_handling: renormalise the three processed probabilities within each age-sex cell
